title: Architecture violation
description: A rule violation with enough source information to display and explain the finding.

rule_id.description: Stable ID of the stored rule that was violated.

message.description: Short summary suitable for a findings list.

source.description: Source component name from the project context.

target.description: Target component name when the finding concerns another component. Omit or use null otherwise.

relationship.description: Relationship involved in the finding, when applicable.

file_path.description: Path relative to the analyzed project root, using forward slashes.

start_line.description: First source line, using one-based numbering.

end_line.description: Last source line, inclusive. The producer must keep this at or after start_line.

explanation.description: Why the source evidence violates the rule.

suggested_correction.description: A suggested change that would satisfy the rule.
